description: Defines the ProgramTable class for managing ELF program headers and memory segments, including loading, memory mapping, and protection adjustments.

classes.name: ProgramTable
classes.description: Manages ELF program headers and segments, including loading, memory reservation, and protection adjustments.

methods.name: LoadProgramHeader
methods.description: Loads the ELF program header from the ELF file.

methods.name: LoadSegments
methods.description: Loads the loadable segments of the ELF file.

methods.name: GetDynamicSection
methods.description: Retrieves the dynamic section table from the ELF.

methods.name: AdjustMemoryProtectionOfReadOnlySegments
methods.description: Modifies memory protections of read-only segments to allow relocations.

methods.name: ReserveLoadMemory
methods.description: Reserves a contiguous, page-aligned memory block for ELF segments.

methods.name: GetBaseMemoryAddress
methods.description: Returns the base load address of the ELF binary.

methods.name: PublishEvergreenInfo
methods.description: Publishes memory mapping info to the EvergreenInfo API.
